verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Dongfengyun Art Village, a hamlet of vineyards, lavender fields and post-modern architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel is situated in Dongfengyun Art Village, a quaint hamlet comprised of vineyards, lavender fields, and post-modern architecture.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's architecture is artistic and all of its buildings are made of red brick.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unique artistic architecture, with all buildings made of red bricks.

verified_facts.text: Guests can experience a local welcome ceremony, a wine-opening ritual and pottery-making sessions.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Life Fitness equipment plus a dry sauna and steam room.

verified_facts.text: Huijing Chinese Restaurant's Cantonese chef serves authentic Cantonese dishes and modern Yunnan cuisine, with wine pairings for each dish.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Cantonese chef specializes in authentic Cantonese dishes and modern Yunnan cuisine, with wine pairings to go with each dish.
